lines.text: Paul and Timothy always thank God for the Colossians' faith and love, which come from a hope stored in heaven.
The Colossians learned the gospel from Barnabas, a faithful minister of Christ, who reported their love in the Spirit.
Paul and Timothy pray that God will fill them with knowledge of His will and strengthen them for endurance.
The Father has rescued us from the dominion of sickness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son.
